note: Admin-editable. Adding or changing a rule needs no code change. Thresholds are operational policy, not model parameters, so they belong here rather than in Python.

then.message: Loading point {loading_point} has been under-trucked for 2 consecutive shifts (MF={match_factor}). Consider reassigning trucks.
Loading point {loading_point} is over-trucked: {n_trucks} trucks, MF={match_factor}, mean wait {avg_queue_wait_min} min. Consider redirecting excess trucks.

rules.name: Bunching Detected

then.message: Trucks arriving at {loading_point} in bunches (CV={cv_interarrival}). Consider spacing dispatch.

rules.threshold_note: The brief specified CV>0.5. Measured on this site that fires on 99.0% of point-shifts (median CV 1.43), so it would be a constant rather than a detector. 3.05 is the 75th percentile of the observed distribution and flags 25%.
